product_one_liner.value: Eden provides a cloud-native diagnostic operating system that combines medical-image management, viewing, reporting, and AI tools for radiologists and healthcare institutions.
product_one_liner.notes: The technology page describes a unified cloud-native replacement for PACS, RIS, viewing, and reporting tools; Eden’s company description identifies its AI capabilities and healthcare-system users: https://edenmed.com/technology and https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/eden-2.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer provide demo/contact routes but no pricing link, and the pricing URL did not yield a usable pricing page: https://edenmed.com/.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Eden’s customer-success entries describe Telerob implementing Eden PACS and Torre Médica obtaining business results from using it: https://edenmed.com/blog. | named_customers.0: The customer-success entry explicitly says Telerob implemented Eden PACS: https://edenmed.com/blog. | named_customers.1: The customer-success title describes Torre Médica’s results from using Eden PACS: https://edenmed.com/blog.

employee_band.notes: The company-reported size range is explicitly 201–500 employees. This is distinct from LinkedIn’s larger associated-profile count and conflicting third-party estimates: https://linkedin.com/company/10809505.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Eden’s company profile explicitly identifies Palo Alto, California as headquarters: https://linkedin.com/company/10809505. | hq_country: Eden’s profile identifies Palo Alto, California as headquarters and the country as the United States. This uses its stated headquarters rather than its Mexican operational location: https://linkedin.com/company/10809505 and https://linkedin.com/company/edenmed-ai.

founded_year.notes: Eden’s company profile explicitly lists its founding year as 2016: https://linkedin.com/company/10809505.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents marketing, customer-success, and radiology-workflow articles, without two engineer-authored posts explaining how Eden’s product is built: https://edenmed.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: Eden has public API documentation with separate articles for orders, studies, appointments, and quotations: https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Eden’s public job board lists an AI Research role with an application link. The posting is Member of Technical Staff, AI Research – Radiology Foundation Model: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/eden-2/jobs/6PuixMH-member-of-technical-staff-ai-research-radiology-foundation-model.

model_provider.notes: Eden explicitly names Eden Cortex as the foundation model that generates radiology reports from medical images: https://linkedin.com/company/edenmed-ai.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Eden’s technology page publicly displays SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA claims: https://edenmed.com/technology. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 is explicitly displayed on https://edenmed.com/technology. | compliance_certs.1: The page displays ISO - 27001, normalized here to ISO 27001: https://edenmed.com/technology. | compliance_certs.2: HIPAA is explicitly displayed on https://edenmed.com/technology.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Both the latest recorded round and its dated report identify the financing as Series A: https://latamlist.com/eden-raises-22m-series-a/. | funding_date: The latest recorded round date is October 10, 2025, matching the dated funding report; expressed in the requested format, this is 2025-10: https://latamlist.com/eden-raises-22m-series-a/. | funding_amount_usd: The latest recorded round agrees with the report that Eden raised $22 million, rather than $22 million in cumulative funding: https://latamlist.com/eden-raises-22m-series-a/.

raised_18mo.notes: The $22 million Series A announced October 10, 2025 falls within the eighteen-month window: https://latamlist.com/eden-raises-22m-series-a/.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Eden’s public job board lists an AI-research opening and no SDR, BDR, or account-executive opening. Similarly named pharmacy-company vacancies were excluded: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/eden-2/jobs.

launched_6mo.notes: Eden introduced Eden Cortex on October 14, 2026, describing new clinical intelligence that understands medical images and generates complete diagnostic reports. This announcement falls within the six-month window: https://linkedin.com/company/edenmed-ai.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A March 2, 2026 report announces Felipe Kitamura’s appointment as Chief Medical Officer, within the twelve-month window: https://exame.com/negocios/eden-inteligencia-artificial-identificar-tumor-cancer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The company-specific technology profile explicitly lists HubSpot Analytics among systems Eden uses. This is a third-party marketing-technology signal, not a confirmed CRM deployment from an Eden job description: https://leadiq.com/c/eden/5ba2b3801e00003201a85de7. | crm_stack_signal.0: HubSpot Analytics is explicitly named among Eden’s technology systems: https://leadiq.com/c/eden/5ba2b3801e00003201a85de7.
